findings.title: Unlimited USDT approval to Uniswap V3 SwapRouter
findings.detail: USDT allowance is 2^256-1 (unlimited) for spender 0xE592427A0AEce92De3Edee1F18E0157C05861564 (Uniswap V3 SwapRouter). That contract can move ALL of your USDT at any time, now and in the future.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or cap this approval (e.g. revoke.cash or Etherscan Token Approvals) unless you actively use this spender every day.

findings.title: Address is an EIP-7702 delegated EOA
findings.detail: The address holds an EIP-7702 delegation (code starts 0xef01): it is an externally-owned account that has temporarily delegated execution to a smart contract. Approvals behave the same, but a delegation can change what the account can do.
findings.recommendation: No action — informational only. Re-scan after changing or revoking the delegation.
